verdict.rationale: Sandbox isolation is a fair question for a coding agent, but the evidence shows no OpenCode sandbox or isolated test environment that keeps production data out of reach. The read-only plan agent is a dry-run analysis mode, not sandbox isolation. The permission config and the GitHub Actions runner are adjacent controls or host-platform capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
